The preview of the full suite (about 23 minutes) hit the default 10-minute background limit and then a kill at about 98% before a third run passed, so the preview needs a longer default limit.
About 69 minutes passed in waiting and re-launching the preview, with no tests failing in the two lost runs.
The session called an undeclared Monitor tool that is disabled for it, then polled output files outside the workspace instead.
The session never opened the triage note or any spec, and did not do the step 7 search of specs outside the plan before the report.
